copy.content006: Equipment and engineering for a complete solution
copy.content007: BM SOLAR develops cleaner energy solutions and continuously improves how we deliver them.
copy.content008: We believe the future of energy comes from matching modern technology to each customer’s needs.
copy.content023: To advance intelligent energy solutions in Vietnam and put modern technology to work.
copy.content026: To bring clean energy to households and businesses through sound engineering and long-term value.
copy.content029: Quality, innovation and customer care guide our work throughout the life of a project.

long: We start with how your site uses electricity. A household may need backup for essential appliances, while a factory may aim to cut grid purchases during production hours.
We review electricity bills, roof area, shade and the grid connection. A proposal should specify equipment, installation scope and the assumptions behind estimated costs.
At handover, customers should know how to read production figures, recognize alerts and find equipment documentation. Bring recent electricity bills and photos of the roof to the first consultation.

inverter-hybrid-deye-5kw-1-pha: A 5 kW single-phase hybrid inverter with generator and battery connections.
Check your simultaneous loads, PV string voltage and battery communication protocol before selecting a system. List essential backup loads and account for motor startup current.
tam-pin-longi-550w-mono-half-cell: LONGi Hi-MO 5 550 W Mono Half-Cell Solar Panel
A mono PERC solar panel rated at 550 W.
Check roof orientation, shading and string voltage against the inverter’s limits. Verify the model and serial numbers before installation.
pin-luu-tru-lithium-deye-5-12kwh: A 51.2 V, 100 Ah battery for compatible hybrid systems.
Compare nominal capacity with usable energy, and confirm the battery voltage and BMS protocol against the inverter specifications.
pin-luu-tru-deye-lithium-rw-m6-1-5-12kwh: A lithium iron phosphate storage module for hybrid power systems.
Size storage for evening use or essential backup loads. Check the RW-M6.1 pairing instructions, charge and discharge limits, and installation clearances.

du-an-ap-mai-biet-thu-quy-nhon-15kw: Hybrid Rooftop Solar at a Quy Nhon Villa
A residential system that combines rooftop solar with battery storage.

The project file records 30 Jinko 550 W panels, a Deye 15 kW three-phase hybrid inverter and three 5.12 kWh Deye battery modules. The inverter and solar array have distinct rated capacities. Monitor monthly generation and when the batteries reach their charge or discharge limits.
he-thong-dien-mat-troi-hybrid-10kwp-go-v: Hybrid Solar at a Go Vap Villa, Ho Chi Minh City
Residential hybrid solar for self-consumption and selected backup loads.
The project uses a Deye hybrid inverter and 18 LONGi 550 W panels. The system should be monitored for daytime generation, grid purchases and battery charge during periods of high demand.
du-an-dien-mat-troi-ap-mai-500kwp-kcn-nh: 500 kWp Industrial Rooftop Solar at Nhon Hoi
Rooftop solar for a seafood processing facility in Nhon Hoi Industrial Park.

Shift-by-shift power readings help determine how much solar generation can be consumed on site. Compare energy figures across similar production hours and weather conditions when reviewing performance.

cam-nang-chon-bien-tan-inverter-hybrid-2: How to Choose a Hybrid Inverter for Your Home
A practical guide to solar input, compatible batteries and essential backup loads.

Start by separating daytime loads, evening loads and appliances that must run during an outage. Then check PV input limits, battery voltage and BMS compatibility, and backup output capacity. A 600 W load running for four hours uses about 2.4 kWh before losses or reserve capacity are taken into account.
huong-dan-chon-inverter-hybrid-va-pin-lu: Choosing a Hybrid Inverter and Battery for Your Home
How to compare grid-tied and hybrid systems and estimate battery size.

Battery power determines how much equipment can run at once. Battery capacity determines how long it can run. Compare quotes using the same list of loads, required backup duration and assumptions about usable energy.

ho-gia-dinh.title: Residential and Villa Solar
ho-gia-dinh.subtitle: Rooftop solar for household self-consumption and optional backup power.
ho-gia-dinh.savings: Depends on daytime usage and system size
ho-gia-dinh.roi: Estimate based on the site and electricity bills
ho-gia-dinh.body: Start with the household’s daytime and evening electricity use. A grid-tied system can serve daytime loads. A compatible hybrid inverter and battery can provide backup to selected appliances if the electrical design includes a dedicated backup circuit.
ho-gia-dinh.benefitsText:
Lower grid purchases | Use solar energy directly when household loads are active.
Backup for essential loads | Size storage around the appliances that need to keep running.
Roof shading | The array reduces direct sun exposure on the covered portion of the roof.
Remote monitoring | Track generation and battery charge in the monitoring app.
ho-gia-dinh.equipmentText:
550 W half-cell solar panels | Canadian Solar | Verify model warranty
Single- or three-phase hybrid inverter | Deye | Verify model warranty
LiFePO4 battery storage | Dyness | Verify model warranty
Protective switchgear enclosure | Schneider or Chint | Verify model warranty
Anodized aluminium mounting rails | BM SOLAR | See project terms
ho-gia-dinh.processText:
Initial consultation | Review recent electricity bills and priorities.
Site survey | Assess roof orientation, shading and structure.
Engineering and pricing | Present the layout and cost assumptions.
Installation and commissioning | Verify wiring and test the system.
Handover and aftercare | Explain monitoring and support procedures.

doanh-nghiep.title: Solar for Business and Commercial Buildings
doanh-nghiep.subtitle: Manage electricity use at offices, hotels and commercial premises.
doanh-nghiep.savings: Depends on the daytime load profile
doanh-nghiep.roi: Estimate based on tariffs, production and project costs
doanh-nghiep.body: Commercial sites benefit most when solar production overlaps with operating hours. Reviewing recent bills and a measured load profile helps size the array and estimate on-site consumption before committing to a design.
doanh-nghiep.benefitsText:
Manage daytime grid demand | Use on-site generation during business hours.
Evaluate returns | Compare cash flows using the same assumptions across proposals.
Support sustainability goals | Record on-site generation for reporting.
Plan installation around operations | Coordinate work with the site team.
doanh-nghiep.equipmentText:
550–660 W PV modules | Canadian Solar or LONGi | Verify model warranty
Three-phase grid-connected inverter | Huawei, Solis or Deye | Verify model warranty
Distribution and surge protection | Schneider or ABB | Verify model warranty
Remote monitoring system | BM Smart Energy | See project terms
Roof mounting and clamps | BM SOLAR | See project terms
doanh-nghiep.processText:
Load assessment | Review bills and measure the demand profile.
Roof and electrical survey | Inspect structure and connection points.
Feasibility and financial estimate | Explain costs, production and payback assumptions.
EPC delivery | Coordinate installation and safety measures.
Commissioning and monitoring | Verify connection and train site operators.

nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.title: Solar for Factories and Industrial Sites
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.subtitle: Large rooftop systems for industrial loads and on-site generation.
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.savings: Depends on production shifts and grid purchases
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.roi: Estimate after a site and load assessment
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.body: Industrial rooftop projects start with structural capacity, fire safety, and the site’s electrical demand by shift. Maintenance access, metering and any export limits should be documented in the engineering and handover plan.
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.benefitsText:
Reduce grid purchases | Use on-site generation against production loads.
Support emissions reporting | Track measured solar production for reporting.
Shade covered roof sections | Reduce direct sunlight on parts of the roof.
Plan for maintenance | Leave access for inspection, cleaning and service.
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.equipmentText:
High-power TOPCon PV modules | Canadian Solar, Jinko or LONGi | Verify model warranty
Industrial string inverter | Huawei or Solis | Verify model warranty
Export control and metering | SmartLogger and current transformers | Verify model warranty
Surge protection and switchgear | Schneider or Phoenix Contact | Verify model warranty
Roof clamps and mounting rails | BM SOLAR | See project terms
nha-xuong-cong-nghiep.processText:
Review structure and safety | Check building and electrical documentation.
Model system production | Assess layout, shade and expected output.
Prepare connection documentation | Coordinate approvals and safety requirements.
Install in stages | Protect production schedules and follow site safety rules.
Test and hand over | Verify equipment, monitoring and operating instructions.
